title: I had this idea
author: Valentinevandal1986
selftext:
I wanted to make a game that’s like Zelda LTTP but also a little bit Dark Souls. I landed on this: 

https://emberheart-five-seals.valentinevandalpc.chatgpt.site

I’m still developing it and fine tuning it but looking for some feedback. The game was created using Astra and Phaser 3 + Typescript. It’s an isometric 2.5d presentation inside a 2d engine allowing for elevation, bridges, cliffs, layered environments.

comments.author: Cupheadvania
comments.body: looks cool, i got lost and then stuck in a valley after falling off the top area. the walking animation needs work and i think the character moves like 10-20% too fast. but i like it! worth continuing

replies.author: Valentinevandal1986
replies.body: Thanks, appreciate you trying it out and the feedback

replies.author: Valentinevandal1986
replies.body: One question: what type of device were you using? I’m aware the touch controls are a little funky and I added a reset room and weights to the options if you get stuck. This is v28 and the animations have really been the toughest part to get right. The characters outfit changes based on the gear and there’s a lot of combinations plus 8 directions so it’s like over 350 frames of animation just for the main character lol. I was trying to make jumping a viable thing but it also means there’s a couple spots you can fall down into valley areas, I got most of it set to spawn you can on the shore you fell off of but with 8 outdoor areas there’s a lot of ground to cover. I’ll be working on a patch over the weekend. This game is an evolution of the first one : https://emberheart-wayfire.valentinevandalpc.chatgpt.site

replies.author: Cupheadvania
replies.body: i’m on iphone 16 pro max. i totally get it. animation is the worst.
